```json
  "event-url" : "/v0/events/ev.d9ImQpReWO2qvCk_wMQjxw",
  "event-type" : "account-status-created",
  "event-payload" : {
    "account-url" : "/v0/bank/accounts/ba.JZjyiHUbXEOqy6YWyaR_Jw",
    "account-status" : "open"
  },
  "created-at" : "2024-01-01T13:30:00.000Z"
}
```

params.name: filter[event-type][eq]
params.description: The type of webhook event. Usually has the form {resource}-{operation}, e.g. payment-updated

params.name: filter[created-at][lte]
params.description: Return only events with a created-at less than or equal to the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[created-at][lt]
params.description: Return only events with a created-at less than the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[created-at][gte]
params.description: Return only events with a created-at greater than or equal to the given timestamp.

params.name: filter[created-at][gt]
params.description: Return only events with a created-at greater than the given timestamp.
